message.content:
The search result identifies the relevant Wikipedia pages. I’m fetching the Moon page for its stated minimum perigee and Kipchoge’s page for the record-making marathon time, then I’ll calculate and round the result.
```python
moon_page = await web_fetch("https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moon", max_chars=12000)
print(moon_page)
```
I have the Moon-page fetch in progress; next I’ll retrieve the athlete’s Wikipedia page separately to avoid relying on incomplete search snippets.
```python
kipchoge_page = await web_fetch("https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eliud_Kipchoge", max_chars=12000)
print(kipchoge_page)
```
Using the Wikipedia values—minimum perigee 356400 km and Kipchoge’s 2:01:09 marathon world record—I’m calculating the duration and rounding to the nearest 1000 hours.
```python
rounded_hours = await calculator("round((356400 / (42.195 / (2 + 1/60 + 9/3600))) / 1000) * 1000")
print(rounded_hours)
```
17000 hours
